_doc: Round 4 paint-over (ESCALATION 2) for the drive-9 back view at 144 px: the glance over the shoulder. Hand-placed on the R4u underlay; STALE if it changes. The head is tilted about 23 deg (from the eye landmarks), so the eyes are drawn stair-stepped in screen space (a rotated upright stamp broke the lash lines into loose pixels).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: a clean, lit face plane under the glance before the features go on (FC-P35).

layers.name: fringe_gaps
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'split the fringe into tapered clumps with 1 px dark gaps'. On the glance a full repaint of the fringe (5 locks) read as a dark visor over the forehead, so only the gaps are cut into the render's own lit fringe.

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic 2/3: 'keep the head turned to camera over the shoulder in back views'; the idle's eye (lash mass with flick, dark-to-light iris, catchlight, cool white) drawn along the tilted eye line.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Attractiveness 3: the asymmetric closed smile, the far corner lifted.

layers.name: strands_out
layers.why: Head and hair 4: loose strands breaking the outline.

layers.name: bell_folds
layers.why: Materials 14 and mass: 'the refs' silhouettes are big cloth shapes; ours reads as flat white planks'; pipe folds as a lavender shadow line with a near-white lit line beside it.

layers.why: DESIGN 3.5 back view: 'the spine curve and the thong-cut back are visible'; body critic: 'the chest lift and back arch do not read'. A soft spine valley in the skin's mid tone.
